title: Audit: Widower's Nest
description: Audit: Widower's Nest — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go Collect 30 Receipts and 6 Expense Reports from the Poison Whiskers and Poison Demon Spawn in Upper Widowers Nest.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Audit: Widower's Nest

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go Collect 30 Receipts and 6 Expense Reports from the Poison Whiskers and Poison Demon Spawn in Upper Widowers Nest.

Offer:

A lot of the Poison division in Widower's went to the recent F3 conference and have failed to file any of their expenses. Without the Receipts and Expense Report we can't take money out of their checks for the things they purchased on their own dime. It looks like the Poison Whiskers in Upper Widower's Nest and the Poison Demon Spawn in the dungeons located off of Upper Widower's Nest need to be taught a lesson about paperwork. I need you to teach them this lesson. Finding the reciepts should not be difficult, but you will need to set up an appointment with the Poison Whisker and Demon Spawn Leaders if you want to get the Expense Reports.

Collect Receipts and Expense Reports from the Poison Whiskers and Poison Demon Spawn in Upper Widower's Nest and return to me, Loremaster Vraile, here in Townston when you have what you need.

Turn-in:

Good job. This will be a perfect time for me to try out my new abacus. The counter beads are actually made out of beans! Real beans! You know, my father was one of the first bean counters. With my new abacus, I really feel like I would be making him proud!

Objectives:

  • Receipts ×30
  • Expense Reports ×6

Level range: 20–40
